slides.title: Overwhelmed by the whole house? Do a brain dump before you clean.
Write down every task in your head
slides.body: Every room, every little thing. 5 minutes, no order. The fog lifts when it's on paper.

slides.title: Circle 3 quick wins
slides.body: Tasks under 5 minutes. Do those first. Quick wins build the momentum to do bigger things.

slides.title: Cross out anything that can wait
slides.body: Deep clean the oven? Not this week. Crossing things off without doing them is allowed.

slides.title: Give the rest a day
slides.body: Spread them across the week. One room or zone a day. Now it's a plan, not a panic.

slides.title: What a brain dump fixes
items: Forgetting what you meant to do
Guilt about the tasks you skip

slides.title: It's not that there's too much to do. It's that it was all in my head at once.
Get the brain dump pages
slides.body: Brain dump sheets and weekly zone planners are in The Tidy Brain Printable Pack. Link in bio.
